svg.text: ERD-1. Full Smart Class PostgreSQL ERD
One-page portrait overview from DB/postgres/init SQL schema. FK direction: parent table -> child table.
This overview keeps all schema tables on one portrait page. Detailed columns for the major tables are provided separately as Mermaid ERD PNGs.
Attachment and export tables share the object-storage metadata pattern; object_deletion_jobs records durable cleanup work after metadata changes.
